number_policy: Numeric table cells and explicit prose only; no digitization of bar heights. Units retained as printed. null is not zero.

LATPC_4K_MAIN.l1_tlb: 32 entries; 16 MSHRs; 20 cycles; 4 ports; fully associative
LATPC_4K_MAIN.baseline: existing warp-instruction page coalescing, no TLB prefetcher
LATPC_4K_MAIN.selection: Author selects VM-pressure workloads by footprint and/or MPKI, then classifies by access regularity and MPKI; TPA exception retained.
LATPC_4K_MAIN.input_shape_status: not specified by Table 3; footprint alone is not a shape
LATPC_4K_MAIN.mpki_denominator: per 1000 instructions; warp-vs-thread counting not resolved in cited table; do not infer

LATPC_2M_EXPANSION.input_change: Regular+High footprint enlarged, average 1.14 GB; other classes not enlarged. Not same-input comparison to main 4KB aggregate.

MEMENTO_SUBCORE10.method: Accel-Sim trace mode; extended Accelwattch RF dynamic-energy model
MEMENTO_SUBCORE10.rf: 2 single-ported banks and 2 OCUs per sub-core; baseline 6 slots/OCU; candidate 8 entries/CCU
MEMENTO_SUBCORE10.candidate: Memento; near/far reuse hint, RTHLD=12; dynamic STHLD interval=10000 cycles; IPC-change threshold 0.02
MEMENTO_SUBCORE10.scale_boundary: Author reduces SM count, L2 size and memory-channel count to one-third of RTX2060 reference; not full-chip RTX2060 evaluation.
MEMENTO_SUBCORE10.profile_boundary: Paper evaluates annotated traces using binary reuse distances and describes offline few-warp profiling; cross-input annotation transfer not established here.
MEMENTO_SUBCORE10.input_shape_status: Table II and cited text do not give all tensor dimensions for named Deepbench variants

VALKYRIE_4K_MAIN.method: MGPUSim AMD GCN3 R9 Nano model
VALKYRIE_4K_MAIN.iommu: CPU side; 8 walkers; Table 1 says 150-cycle latency without per-level designation
VALKYRIE_4K_MAIN.candidate: LDT100, intra-SE ring; L1 storage split104 demand+24 prefetch
VALKYRIE_4K_MAIN.input_shape_status: Table 2 gives footprints, not exact input dimensions
VALKYRIE_4K_MAIN.aggregate_membership: Do not assign paper mean to each of ten rows; sensitive/insensitive groups shown separately and neighboring mean statements do not always repeat sample membership.

NEUMMU_V1_DENSE.version: arXiv:1911.06859v1, 2019-11-15; not verified final conference PDF
NEUMMU_V1_DENSE.method: TPU-style systolic simulation; fixed memory latency/bandwidth, not cycle-level DRAM simulator
NEUMMU_V1_DENSE.spm_text_discrepancy: §III-C example uses 10 MB each; not silently reconciled with Table I
NEUMMU_V1_DENSE.baseline_walk: 8 PTWs; 100 cycles per level; four-level x86-64-like
NEUMMU_V1_DENSE.normalization: author oracular MMU, not AWMA S_ALL and not a universal upper bound
NEUMMU_V1_DENSE.scope_warning: large batches32/64/128 use a representative layer subset, not complete training executions

NEUMMU_V1_SPARSE_MIGRATION.locator: §VI-A Fig16 p11; distinct from §V NUMA Fig15
NEUMMU_V1_SPARSE_MIGRATION.treatment: demand-paged sparse embedding experiments, 4 KB vs 2 MB
NEUMMU_V1_SPARSE_MIGRATION.scope_warning: Includes page movement/granularity costs; not only translation-service latency. NUMA batch values elsewhere must not be substituted.
